        2. R&D PROGRESS: DEEP INTEGRATION OF                                                                                                    2. 研發進展：AI+機器人+MULTI-
        AI, ROBOTICS, AND MULTI- AGENT; HOW THE                                                                                                 AGENT深度融合，飛輪效應重塑
        FLYWHEEL EFFECT IS RESHAPING THE R&D                                                                                                    研發範式
        PARADIGM


                          2228.HK                     AI-Driven Design & Prediction → Robotic Wet-Lab Experiments

Originating from the MIT campus on the banks of the Charles River, XtalPi        晶泰科技起源於位於查爾斯河畔的麻省理工學
was founded in 2015 by three physicists. The Company is an innovative            院(MIT)校園，2015年由三位物理學家創立，
technology platform company driven by quantum physics, empowered                 是一家基於量子物理、以人工智能賦能和機器
by artificial intelligence (AI), and powered by robotics. Since its inception,   人驅動的創新平台型科技公司。自創立以來，
the Company has consistently pursued independent innovation as the               公司始終將自主創新作為發展的核心驅動力，
core driver of its development, and continuously increased investment in         持續加大研發投入，利用量子物理、人工智
research and development. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies such           能、雲計算、機器人實驗等前沿技術領域打造
as quantum physics, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and robotic        了面向未來產業的創新型研發平台。該平台憑
experiments, the Company has built an innovative R&D platform oriented           藉共性技術集成優勢，滿足微觀分子世界探索
towards future industries. This platform, benefiting from the integration        的需求，在生物醫藥行業成效顯著，大幅提升

Board of Directors             As the highest responsible body for the management and public disclosure of the
董事會                            Company’s ESG matters, the Board of Directors bears ultimate responsibility and
                               primarily exercises the following functions:
                               •   Reviewing the materiality of risks and issues related to the Company’s ESG matters;
                               •   Reviewing and approving the Company’s sustainability strategy and goals;
                               •   Overseeing and reviewing the Company’s policies, management, performance, and progress
                                   towards related goals in ESG matters; and
                               •   Reviewing and approving the public disclosure of the Company’s performance on ESG-related
                                   matters.
                               董事會作為公司ESG事宜管理及公開披露的最高責任機構，承擔最終責任，主要行使以下職能：
                               •   審議本公司ESG事宜相關風險及議題重要性；
                               •   審議、批准公司可持續發展戰略與目標；
                               •   監督、檢討本公司ESG事宜相關政策、管理、表現及相關目標進度；
                               •   審議、批准本公司就ESG相關事宜表現的公開披露。

ESG Working Group              Comprised of the Company’s senior management and heads of various business and
ESG工作組                         functional departments, the ESG Working Group serves as the primary supervisory and
                               coordinating body, primarily exercising the following functions and providing support
                               to the Board:
                               •   Allocating resources for the implementation of the Company’s ESG strategy and the
                                   achievement of ESG goals;
                               •   Formulating ESG policies and action plans that align with the Company’s sustainability
                                   strategy and objectives;
                               •   Managing ESG-related risks in the Company’s day-to-day operations;
                               •   Communicating with relevant departments, branches and subsidiaries of the Company to
                                   coordinate and advance the implementation of ESG initiatives; and
                               •   Reviewing the public disclosure of the Company’s performance on ESG-related matters.
                               ESG工作組由公司高管以及各業務、職能部門負責人組成，作為主要監督及協調機構，主要行
                               使以下職能並為董事會提供支持：
                               •   為公司ESG策略的實施及ESG目標的實現分配資源；
                               •   制定符合本公司可持續發展戰略與目標的ESG事宜相關政策及行動計劃；
                               •   管理本公司日常運營過程的ESG相關風險；
                               •   負責與本公司相關部門、分子公司的溝通，協調推進ESG相關事宜落地執行；
                               •   審閱本公司就ESG相關事宜表現的公開披露。

          Deepening Industry-University-Research Collaborative Innovation                深化產學研協同創新


            Hosting “New Paradigm of Synthetic Chemistry Research – Robotics Integrated with AI Symposium” to Promote
            Academic and Industrial Exchanges
            主辦「合成化學研究新範式－機器人融合AI研討會」，推動學術與產業交流

            In June 2025, XtalPi hosted the “New Paradigm of Synthetic Chemistry Research – Robotics Integrated with AI
            Symposium” in Shanghai. Academician Ma Shengming from Fudan University served as the Chairman of the Symposium.
            Experts and scholars from universities, research organisations and industrial institutions including Tsinghua University and
            Peking University participated in the exchanges, with more than 300 offline attendees. The Symposium focused on the
            integrated application of robotics and artificial intelligence in the field of synthetic chemistry, and conducted in-depth
            discussions on data-driven R&D and intelligent paradigms. During the Symposium, the Company demonstrated how its
            self-developed intelligent autonomous experimentation platform improves the efficiency of chemical space exploration.
            2025年6月，晶泰科技在上海主辦「合成化學研究新範式－機器人融合AI研討會」。會議由復旦大學麻生明院士擔任大會
            主席，清華大學、北京大學等高校、科研機構和產業機構的專家學者參與交流，線下參會者逾300人。會議聚焦機器人
            技術與人工智能在合成化學領域的融合應用，深入探討了數據驅動研發及智能化範式。期間，公司展示了自主研發的智
            能自主實驗平台如何提升化學空間探索效率。

            This Symposium provided an exchange platform for all sectors of industry, university and research, promoted cross-
            border cooperation among artificial intelligence, robotics and synthetic chemistry research, and offered practical exchange
            opportunities for advancing the new data-driven scientific research paradigm.
            本次研討會為產學研各界提供了交流平台，促進了人工智能、機器人技術與合成化學研究的跨界合作，為推動數據驅動
            的科研新範式提供了實踐交流機會。

Hosting the 2026 International Symposium on Molecular Glue Drug Discovery to Build a Joint Innovation
Ecosystem for Molecular Glues
舉辦2026分子膠藥物研發國際研討會，共建分子膠創新生態

In January 2026, the 2026 International Symposium on Molecular Glue Drug Discovery, hosted by XtalPi, was held in
Shanghai. Experts, scholars and industry representatives from leading domestic and overseas research institutions and
biomedical enterprises attended the event, including Stanford University, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, École Polytechnique
Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL), Shanghai Institute of Organic Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences, and ShanghaiTech
University, engaging in in-depth discussions on cutting-edge R&D developments.
2026年1月，由晶泰科技主辦的「2026分子膠藥物研發國際研討會」在上海召開，來自斯坦福大學、Dana-Farber癌症研究
所、瑞士洛桑聯邦理工學院(EPFL)、中國科學院上海有機化學研究所、上海科技大學等海內外科研機構及多家生物醫藥
企業的專家學者與產業代表參會，深度探討研發前沿。

At the symposium, XtalPi shared its XGlue™ molecular glue R&D platform built on AI and automation technologies, as
well as related practical achievements, demonstrating the technical pathway of enhancing the efficiency and success rate
of molecular glue discovery through data-driven and full-process digital management. The symposium further gathered
global innovation resources, facilitated collaboration between academia and industry, and provided important support for
the high-quality development of molecular glue drug R&D.
晶泰科技在會上分享了基於AI與自動化技術構建的XGlue™分子膠研發平台及相關實踐成果，展示了以數據驅動和全流
程數字化管理提升分子膠發現效率與成功率的技術路徑。此次研討會進一步匯聚全球創新資源，促進學術界與產業界協
同合作，為分子膠藥物研發邁向高質量發展階段提供了重要支撐。

Eco-Friendly & Caring Computer Donation to Shiwang Middle School, Yangchun City, Guangdong Province
廣東省陽春市石望中學綠色愛心電腦捐贈

From 2024 to 2025, Shenzhen Jingtai Technology Co., Ltd. conducted public welfare donations through the Guangdong
Education Foundation. The Company professionally refurbished a batch of recycled computers and assembled them into
47 sets of compliant equipment. In December 2025, 41 sets were donated to Shiwang Middle School in Yangchun City,
helping the school establish an “Eco-Friendly & Caring Computer Classroom”. This initiative has effectively improved
teaching facilities and provided students with a modern digital learning environment.
2024至2025年，深圳晶泰科技有限公司通過廣東省教育基金會開展公益捐贈。公司首先將一批回收電腦經專業技術整
修，組裝成47套達標設備。2025年12月，其中41套捐贈至陽春市石望中學，助力學校建成「綠色愛心電腦教室」，有效
改善了教學設備條件，為學生提供了現代化的數字學習環境。




Donation Relief for Tai Po Fire, Hong Kong
香港大埔火災捐贈援助

On the afternoon of November 26, 2025, a serious fire broke out at Wang Fuk Court, Tai Po, Hong Kong. The
disaster received widespread public attention, and various sectors of the community actively participated in rescue and
reconstruction support. On December 2, 2025, XtalPi donated HK$1.5 million to the Support Fund for Wang Fuk Court in
Tai Po, established by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to support post-disaster relief and
rehabilitation efforts.
2025年11月26日下午，香港大埔宏福苑發生嚴重火災，災情引發社會廣泛關注，各界積極投入救援及重建支持工作。
2025年12月2日，晶泰科技通過香港特區政府設立的「大埔宏福苑援助基金」捐贈150萬港元，用於支持災後救助及善後
工作。

Risk management                                                              風險管理
The Company has established a complete closed climate risk management        公司已建立涵蓋風險識別、分級應對與持續監
loop covering risk identification, graded response and continuous            控的完整氣候風險管理閉環，以系統性提升公
monitoring to systematically enhance the Company’s resilience to address     司應對氣候變化的韌性。
climate change.

   Risk Identification and       •   Communicating with stakeholders through industry analysis, identifying and
   Assessment Methods                continuously updating the list of climate risks and opportunities, and evaluating their
     風險識別與評估方法                       impacts on the Company’s business through qualitative and quantitative analysis. For
                                     the physical risks, we combine the Company’s actual operating data with external
                                     authoritative databases (such as WWF, CLIMADA, etc.) to quantitatively evaluate
                                     the physical risks. For the transition risks, we judge them by integrating internal and
                                     external data models and the management’s opinions.
                                     通過行業分析與利益相關方溝通，識別並持續更新氣候風險與機遇清單，並通過定
                                     性與定量分析評估其業務影響。對於物理風險，我們結合公司實際運營數據與外部
                                     權威數據庫（如WWF、CLIMADA等）進行實體風險量化評估；對於轉型風險，則綜
                                     合內外部數據模型及管理層意見進行研判。


    Risk Ranking and             •   According to the set risk threshold, we divide climate issues into three grades,
    Countermeasures                  namely high, medium and low. According to different grades, we adopt regular
    風險排序與應對措施                        monitoring, special measures and systematic schemes to manage them, and ensure
                                     the benefits of measures through financial quantitative analysis and continuous
                                     optimization.
                                     依據設定的風險閾值，我們將氣候議題分為高、中、低三個分級。針對不同等級，
                                     我們分別採取常態化監測、專項措施和系統化方案進行管理，並通過財務量化分析
                                     與持續優化來確保措施的效益。


    Risk Monitoring and          •   We incorporate climate risks into the Company’s overall risk management
     Control Procedures              process, and the ESG Working Group regularly evaluates climate-related risks and
    風險監測與控制程序                        opportunities. The evaluation results and control effectiveness will be reported to
                                     the Board of Directors as the basis for its review and optimization of management
                                     strategies.
                                     我們將氣候風險納入公司整體風險管理流程，由ESG工作組定期評估氣候相關風險
                                     與機遇。評估結果與管控成效將上報董事會，作為其審閱和優化管理策略的依據。

of the People’s Republic of China (《中華人民共和國環境保護法》), the                           《中華人民共和國環境影響評價法》《 中華人民

          The Company deeply integrates the concept of green and low carbon into          公司將綠色低碳理念深度融入技術研發與產業

          the R&D processes in medicine, materials, chemicals and other fields,           流程、突破關鍵技術瓶頸、顯著提升資源利用
          breaks through key technical bottlenecks, significantly improves the            效率，攜手合作夥伴在研發源頭共同推進低碳
          resource utilisation efficiency, and works with partners to jointly promote     轉型，邁向碳中和未來。
          low-carbon transition at the source of R&D and move towards a carbon-
          neutral future.


            AI + Building Materials Accelerate the Process of the “Dual Carbon” Goals in Infrastructure Construction
            AI+建築材料加速基建「雙碳」目標進程

            XtalPi strategically cooperates with Zhongyan Dadi (中岩大地) to empower green R&D of construction materials with AI
            technology. The two parties will focus on the field of geotechnical stabilisers and soft soil stabilisation, develop special
            geotechnical materials and overcome application problems by a domain-specific model for construction materials and
            an AI-driven intelligent design system, and realise the transition of the R&D mode of building materials through AI
            technology. The results of cooperation will be directly used to serve major national infrastructure projects and are expected
            to reduce the carbon emissions of geotechnical engineering and provide support for realisation of the “dual carbon” goals
            in the construction field.
            晶泰科技與中岩大地戰略合作，以AI技術賦能建築材料綠色研發。雙方將聚焦岩土固化材料領域，借助構建材料垂類模
            型和AI驅動設計系統，研製特種岩土材料並攻克應用難題，同時通過AI技術實現建築材料研發模式躍遷。合作成果將直
            接服務於國家重大基建項目，預計可降低岩土工程碳排放，為建築領域「雙碳」目標實現提供支撐。


            AI+ Agriculture Creates Super Crops and Leads the Response to Climate Change
            AI+農業打造超級作物，引領應對氣候變局

            Relying on its mature AI protein design platform, XtalPi has reached a cooperation with Shanghai CyberplantX Biotech
            Co., Ltd. (上海柒彩之心生物科技有限公司). The two parties will jointly build the “Intelligent Evolution Engine” of plants
            based on the massive plant genomic variation and phenotype database of its CyberplantX platform, so as to realise rapid
            and directional cultivation and R&D of improved varieties and give birth to the next generation of safe, resilient, green
            and cost-effective super crops, so as to cope with the escalating climate change challenge. Driven by AI technology,
            the evolution of critical functional proteins can be precisely designed and modified, so as to make existing plants more
            adaptable to extreme climate change.
            晶泰科技依託其成熟的AI蛋白設計平台，與上海柒彩之心生物科技有限公司達成合作。雙方將基於柒彩之心旗下
            CyberplantX平台的海量植物基因變異序列與表型庫，共同打造植物的「智能進化引擎」，以實現快速、定向的良種培育研
            發，催生下一代安全、抗壓、綠色、經濟的超級作物，以應對持續升級的氣候變化挑戰。在AI技術的驅動下，關鍵功能
            蛋白的進化是可以被精確設計與改造，使現有植物更加適應極端氣候變化。

          The Group mainly leases offices as lessee. Lease terms are negotiated on          本集團作為承租人主要租賃辦公室。租賃條款
          an individual basis and contain various terms and conditions.                     以個體基準進行磋商並載有各種條款及條件。

          Each lease payment is allocated between the liability and finance cost.           債及財務成本之間作出分配。財務成本在租賃
          The finance cost is charged to profit or loss over the lease period so as to      期於損益扣除，藉以令各個期間的負債的剩餘

          the liability for each period. The right-of-use asset is depreciated over the     線法以資產可使用年期及租期（以較短者為準）
          shorter of the asset’s useful life and the lease term on a straight-line basis.   計算折舊。

          are also included in the measurement of the liability.                            納入負債計量中。

          • variable lease payment that are based on an index or a rate, initially          • 基於指數或利率的可變租賃付款，初始使用

To determine the incremental borrowing rate, the Group:                         為釐定增量借款利率，本集團：

• where possible, uses recent third-party financing received by the             • 在可能情況下，使用個別承租人最近獲得的
